rows.name: help-maint-frames
rows.why: sniff's own maintenance command
expect: Name how each frame of the stack was unwound.
Each frame is named with unwind=cfi (its call frame information),
unwind=frame-pointer (the frame-pointer fallback) or, for the last frame, unwind=outermost.
This is sniff's own command; gdb has no maintenance command of this name.
